name: calflint/keelhob
description: Development toolchain for the Keelhob WordPress plugin. The plugin itself has NO runtime dependencies — `require` below is deliberately empty and no vendor/ directory is ever shipped. Composer is used here only to install static-analysis tooling for developers and CI.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the custom unit suite (tests/run.php). No PHPUnit, no database.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan level 1 over the plugin against the committed baseline.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run `php -l` over every PHP file in the repo, excluding vendor/.
scripts-descriptions.lint:skills: Score every skill against docs/SKILL-STANDARD.md. This is the pull-request rubric.
scripts-descriptions.skills:build: Regenerate the skill catalogue, the standard doc, and the tree table in build-standard.md.
